faq_title: Why can't I access some websites?
faq_body: Certain sites are restricted to maintain security and productivity. If you believe a site is wrongly blocked, please send a request to ict.servicedesk@miescor.ph and complete the Application Access/Install Form.

faq_title: I can't connect to the internet. What should I do?
faq_body: Please check:Network cable or Wi-Fi connection Restart your PC or reconnect to Wi-Fi If the problem persists, contact the ICT Servicedesk via ict.servicedesk@miescor.ph / 09999934662 with your device name, company number, WiFi MAC Address, location, and time of issue.

faq_title: How do I connect to the company Wi-Fi?
faq_body: For employees: Contact the Servicedesk with your device name, company number, WiFi MAC Address and location.For Guests: Contact the Service Desk to obtain your password. Connect to the 'IAM' network, then open a browser and follow the instructions provided by the Service Desk.

faq_title: How often should I change my password?
faq_body: Every 90 days, following the company's security policy. Passwords must be at least 12 characters long and include letters, numbers, and symbols.

faq_title: I forgot my password'what should I do?
faq_body: Contact the ICT Servicedesk via ict.servicedesk@miescor.ph / 09999934662

faq_title: Why do I keep getting prompted to sign in?
faq_body: This can happen due to:Expired passwords Cached credentials Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) settings Try clearing browser cookies or re-adding your account in Outlook.

faq_title: What happens when I lock my account?
faq_body: If you type your password wrong several times, your account may lock for security reasons. Wait a few minutes, or contact ICT Servicedesk via ict.servicedesk@miescor.ph / 09999934662 to unlock it.

faq_title: Can I use the same password for multiple accounts?
faq_body: No, it's recommended to use a unique password for each account to reduce security risks.

faq_title: How do I submit a request to create a new email account?
faq_body: To request a new Office 365 email account: 1. Gather required information: Full Name, PERNR, Position/ Role Name, Subarea, Project Business Unit, Name of Organization Unit, Employee Status, Cost Center, Contact Number and Manager 2. Submit the request: Send an email to ict.servicedesk@miescor.ph 3. Approval: Ensure the request is approved by HRBP or the department manager if required. 4. IT creation: The IT team will create the mailbox, configure access, and apply security settings. 5. Notification: The new user will receive login credentials and setup instructions via SMS 6. First login: Change the temporary password, set up MFA, and configure Outlook on your devices.

faq_title: How do I access my O365 email?
faq_body: Web: Go to https://portal.office.com and sign in with your work account. Desktop: Use the Outlook application (part of Microsoft Office). Mobile: Download the Outlook app from the App Store (iOS) or Google Play Store (Android).

faq_title: What is MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication)?
faq_body: MFA adds an extra security layer by requiring a code or app verification in addition to your password.

faq_title: How can I report a suspected phishing email or network attack?
faq_body: Forward suspicious emails to Miescor Cybersecurity Group via csg@miescor.ph or the ICT Servicedesk via ict.servicedesk@miescor.ph immediately. Do not click any links or download attachments.

faq_title: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
faq_body: Contact the ICT Service Desk to verify your identity and reset your password.

faq_title: My computer is running slow. What should I do?
faq_body: Restart your computer, close unused applications, and check for updates. If the issue continues, contact the Service Desk for further troubleshooting.

faq_title: I can't connect to Wi-Fi.
faq_body: Check Wi-Fi. settings, ensure Airplane Mode is off, and restart your device. If it still doesn't connect, contact the Service Desk with details.

faq_title: My email is not syncing / I can't send or receive emails.
faq_body: Check your internet connection and mailbox size. Try signing out and back in. If unresolved, provide the Service Desk with a screenshot or error message.

faq_title: Printer isn't working.
faq_body: Ensure the printer is powered on, connected to the network, and has paper/toner. Restart your PC. If still not printing, send the printer name and error details to the Service Desk.

faq_title: How do I request new software or system access?
faq_body: Submit an Access Request Form via email. All requests must be approved.

faq_title: Who should I reach out to regarding ICT concerns / assistance?
faq_body: Contact the ICT Servicedesk via ict.servicedesk@miescor.ph

faq_title: SAP logon says Connection to partner failed.
faq_body: This usually means the server is offline for maintenance or network connectivity is unstable. Wait a few minutes before retrying.

faq_title: My SAP GUI freezes during use.
faq_body: Close unused sessions and avoid multiple heavy reports. Single SAP Login can only handle 6 open windows per user.  If persistent, IT can check memory allocation or system connectivity.

faq_title: Documents are not printing from SAP.
faq_body: Verify printer setup and default device assignment. If the issue affects multiple users, IT will check the print server spooler.

faq_title: SAP is slow today.
faq_body: High concurrent usage or background jobs can temporarily affect speed. IT monitors performance logs; report persistent issues for analysis.

faq_title: I keep getting disconnected from SAP
faq_body: Check your network stability. Make sure to connect to the right SAP Router. Raise ticket to ICT Servicedesk if issue is persistent.

faq_title: How often should I change my password?
faq_body: Every 90 days, or immediately if you suspect compromise. For locked out accounts, raise ticket to ICT Servicedesk.
